location: Article 113, third paragraph, point (b), Irish version

en.title: AI Act, Irish version: Article 113(b) does not except Article 101 from the date of 2 August 2025
en.summary: The other 23 versions add with the exception of Article 101. Read alone, the Irish wording includes Article 101 (fines for providers of general-purpose AI models) in the provisions applying from 2 August 2025.
en.impact: Read alone, the Irish text makes the fines of Article 101 apply one year earlier than the other versions.
en.correction: Add the exception of Article 101 to Irish Article 113, third paragraph, point (b).

quote_translations.q1: Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII and Chapter XII and Article 78 shall apply from 2 August 2025;

ga.title: An Gníomh um an Intleacht Shaorga, leagan Gaeilge: ní eisiann Airteagal 113(b) Airteagal 101 ón dáta 2 Lúnasa 2025
ga.summary: Tá eisceacht maidir le hAirteagal 101 sna 23 leagan eile. Má léitear ina aonar é, áirítear Airteagal 101 (fíneálacha do sholáthraithe samhlacha intleachta saorga ilchuspóireacha) leis na forálacha a bhfuil feidhm acu ón 2 Lúnasa 2025.
ga.impact: Má léitear ina aonar é, bheadh feidhm ag fíneálacha Airteagal 101 bliain níos luaithe de réir an téacs Gaeilge ná de réir na leaganacha eile.
ga.correction: An eisceacht maidir le hAirteagal 101 a chur le hAirteagal 113, an tríú mír, pointe (b), den leagan Gaeilge.

quotes.source: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 (Artificial Intelligence Act), Official Journal, 12 July 2024, Irish version
